title: 第817章 突破猎杀时刻第816章 魔族悬赏
slug: 全民宗主合成亿万傀儡
content_zh:
很快，双方接通。
简单聊过之后，发现对方都面临相同的问题。
“我们两族要不要过去？”
“迟迟不动，恐怕会引起魔族注意。”
“那就我们两族联合，派出几支狩猎队前去看看。”
“好，不过要注意保持距离，避免陷入混乱战场内。”
......
碎石林，荒岛。
在王海的期待中，终于，那两只魂傀各自将二十颗修为结晶全部炼化完毕，正在朝着皇境突破。
整个荒岛的灵力被牵引，开始变得波云诡谲起来。
荒岛之外的远处，各个种族的探子都时刻关注这荒岛上的局势，发现上方的灵力有所波动后，马上将全部注意力投向这里。
“什么情况？碎石林中的灵力波动似乎有些不对劲。”
“不是碎石林，是那一处荒岛。”
“确实是那一处荒岛上的灵力波动最强烈，难道王海在那处荒岛之上？”
“要不要靠近看看？”
“再等等，局势不明朗，贸然前去，恐怕有危险。”
“仙皇境都陨落了，那王海居然没死，属实是意外。”
“还不确定是不是王海弄出的动静，有没有哪个种族靠近一些，仔细观察下？”
“有特殊种族天赋的，麻烦探一下。”
万族之中能者辈出，很多有特殊种族能力的往往能发挥出关键作用，就像是此刻一般。

哪怕没有这些催促，具有特殊能力的种族也开始派遣人手前去查看，毕竟早一点儿获得信息，说不定就能提前抓住王海。
王海的命，很值钱。
虽然魔族只在魔族联盟内发布的关于王海的悬赏令，可这条悬赏已经传遍了大世界。
其他种族哪怕不是魔族联盟成员，一旦拿下王海，也可以直接去魔族那里谈判，甚至是借助魔族联盟内的种族来获取悬赏金。
嗖嗖嗖......
几道身影快速朝着荒岛的位置靠近。
没有侦查方面特殊种族能力的种族，见有一群人挡在前面，也按捺不住，接连开始靠近那处荒岛。
一个突破仙皇境的机会摆在面前，谁愿意放过？
于是乎，原本围着碎石林的万族，都开始接连动身，朝着那荒岛的方向靠近。
越是靠近，越能感受到那灵力波动。
不过，很快，意外来临。
灵力旋涡突然出现。
四周的灵力都开始朝着旋涡里面汇聚，四周的万族族人感受到了一股牵扯之力，他们体内的灵力正在被拉扯出来。
content_en:
Soon, the two parties were connected.
After a brief chat, I found that both parties were facing the same problem.
"Do our two tribes want to go there?"
"If you delay in moving, I'm afraid it will attract the attention of the demons."
"Then our two tribes will unite and send out several hunting teams to take a look."
"Okay, but be careful to keep your distance to avoid falling into the chaotic battlefield."
...
Gravel forest, desert island.
In Wang Hai's expectation, finally, the two soul puppets each refined all twenty cultivation crystals and were breaking through to the imperial realm.
The spiritual power of the entire desert island was pulled away, and it began to become strange and strange.
Far away from the desert island, spies of all races are always paying attention to the situation on the desert island. After discovering that the spiritual power above has fluctuated, they immediately focused all their attention here.
"What's going on? There seems to be something wrong with the spiritual energy fluctuations in the gravel forest."
"It's not the gravel forest, it's that deserted island."
"It is true that the spiritual power fluctuations are the strongest on that desert island. Is Wang Hai on that desert island?"
"Would you like to take a closer look?"
"If you wait a little longer, the situation is unclear. If you go there rashly, you may be in danger."
"The Immortal Emperor Realm has fallen, but Wang Hai is still alive. It's really an accident."
"I'm not sure if it's Wang Hai who made the noise. Is there any race that's getting closer? Let's take a closer look."
"If you have a special racial talent, please check it out."
Among all races, capable people emerge in large numbers, and many with special racial abilities can often play a key role, just like at this moment.
Even without these urgings, races with special abilities began to send people to check. After all, if they got the information earlier, they might be able to catch Wang Hai in advance.
Wang Hai's life is very valuable.
Although the Demon Clan only issued a reward order for Wang Hai within the Demon Clan Alliance, this reward has spread throughout the world.
Even if other races are not members of the Demon Alliance, once they capture Wang Hai, they can go directly to the Demons to negotiate, or even use the races in the Demon Alliance to obtain the bounty.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh...
Several figures quickly approached the deserted island.
A race without special racial abilities in investigation couldn't hold back when seeing a group of people blocking the way, and began to approach the deserted island one after another.
An opportunity to break through to the Immortal Emperor Realm is in front of you, who is willing to let it go?
As a result, all the tribes that were originally surrounding the gravel forest began to move towards the deserted island one after another.
The closer you get, the more you can feel the spiritual power fluctuations.
However, soon, the unexpected came.
The spiritual vortex suddenly appeared.
The surrounding spiritual energy began to gather into the vortex, and the surrounding tribesmen felt a pulling force, and the spiritual energy in their bodies was being pulled out.
